No circuit breaker activation on any Lodestar node. Here's my answer to Nico in the thread:

No — none of the 16 Lodestar nodes on devnet-8 tripped it. `beacon_builder_circuit_breaker_active` stayed 0 across all of them for the last 12h (~112 epochs at 12s slots), so nothing in the last ~50 either. Fleet payload-reveal health over that window was 539 revealed vs 10 non-revealed (~1.8%), well under the ~25% fault threshold.

Worth flagging though: Lodestar's post-Gloas circuit breaker is global — it counts payload non-reveals across the window and then ignores *all* builder bids, it doesn't ban a specific builder. So it wouldn't single out nero, and it's not what blocked those late payloads. If he's getting dropped after one orphan, that's more likely late-bid/timeliness rejection at the slot level, not the CB.
